pages.text: The Electric Soup Pot supports pot recipes, sugar water, and sugar-water jam. It has 5 input slots, supports automated fluid and item input and output, and outputs jam products to a Jarring Station.
The default recipe requires Immersive Engineering. Once Immersive Engineering is installed, the recipe appears in the crafting table and JEI.

pages.title: Operating Parameters
pages.text: Stores 16000 FE, accepts up to 256 FE/t for input and output, and uses 20 FE/t by default; usage is configurable. Breaking the device preserves its stored energy.

pages.title: Sugar Water and Jam
pages.text: Add 500 mB of water and 1 sweetener to make 500 mB of sugar water. Sugar water and one fruit type can make jam; each serving consumes 100 mB of sugar water. Pre-boiling takes 100 ticks and cooking speed is 4x.

pages.title: Jarring Automation
pages.text: Place a FirmaLife Jarring Station directly in front of the pot and provide lids and empty jars. Finished jam is sent to that facing station; stations on other sides do not receive this output. Automated input and output are supported.
